setup_protocol: For each case start fresh roots with initialized simulation profiles, dimensions3/2, then link without dimension change. Apply setup_imports in listed order to the named root as independent imports with finalization=false. Each import has fresh first-header recognition. Linked seed is a direct import into that root, not alternate-root dispatch. Do not count setup events in action offsets/read counts.

observation_plan.handlers: After handler return use HandlerObserver to compare offset,cursor,status and all metadata; in CURSIM failure case15 assert zeros before later TITLE event.
observation_plan.helper_reads: Use separate future helper-level calls with KeywordReader(data,handler_entry_cursor), public name/material_name/integer_triple, and line_reads() to compare attempt count, status, offsets/cursors and bytes. Current HandlerObserver does not expose reader internals.
observation_plan.headers: Comments/headers have no HandlerObserver callback. Final both-root state is asserted for header-only actions12/13/16/17. Trace header snapshots are source-derived future probe targets, not claims of current callback availability.
observation_plan.native: Native captures need separate authorization and record file mode/CRT/locale; translated cursor fields are not promises about native ftell.
